description:
Chat with your friends. Read the conversation in the language you’re learning. Vipi automatically translates messages you send and receive, so your friends can write as usual.

For supported non-Latin scripts, Latin-letter reading guides appear by default. Tap a message to hear it in full in the language you are learning. Press and hold the message area to reveal meanings in your own language; release to return. Double-tap to switch between the reading guide and the language’s native script.

Want to hear new messages automatically? Turn on autoplay with the speaker control at the top of the chat. New sent and received messages play in the language you are learning. Turn it off to stop.

Translation requires downloaded language models and runs on your device, not through an online translation service. Available languages, reading guides and voices depend on your device and downloads. Translations can be wrong.

Keep your conversations private
Connect through usernames and invitations. Chats with friends are end-to-end encrypted. You can save an encrypted history backup to a location you choose.

Talk with vBot
Bot mini is an optional additional plan for chatting with vBot, a chatbot. Messages you send to vBot go to our response provider, and automated replies can be mistaken. You see the monthly reply allowance before subscribing.

Start with 30 days free
Your first 30 days of Vipi are free, without starting a subscription or providing payment details. After that, choose whether to subscribe. There is no automatic charge when the free period ends. In the US, Vipi is $12 per year. Bot mini is a separate optional $48-per-year subscription and requires active Vipi access. Bot mini offers its own one-month free trial for eligible subscribers. Your store shows the local price and renewal date before purchase. Subscriptions you choose renew automatically unless canceled through your store. You can still read and export your existing local history after access ends.
